summary: Mineral County, MT tower on the Lolo NF: an L-4 tower dated 1936 and destroyed in 1962 per firelookout.com; the Forest Lookouts list says removed.

facts.status_note: Not standing. The sources differ on how it ended: destroyed in 1962, or removed with no date.

events.note: firelookout.com gives destroyed 1962; the Forest Lookouts list gives removed, undated

evidence.supports: Mineral County; Lolo National Forest; land description 20N-30W-36; status removed
evidence.quote: MINERAL COUNTY CAMERON PEAK Lolo National Forest 20N-30W-36 Removed

notes_for_editor: Only firelookout.com gives a build year (1936) and a destruction year (1962). The Forest Lookouts list gives removed with no date, so the story reports both. The 2020 Cameron Peak Fire in Colorado comes up in search results; it is unrelated. No staffing, fire or access information was found in the sources read. Record status gone is consistent with all three sources.
